The owner, technicians, front desk and outside contacts with phone, pay model and hours; utilisation, revenue and pay this month and booth rent still owed fill in by themselves.
Pay runs with total cost and days late
One row per staff member and month: takings, tips, hours, commission or hourly pay and booth rent; total cost to the studio, days late, the open flag and the pay check fill in by themselves.
Technician months with utilisation and revenue per hour
One row per technician and month: appointments, booked and available minutes, revenue, tips, retail, new clients and no-shows; utilisation, revenue per booked hour and the target check fill in.
Technician days with the overload flag
One row per technician and day: appointments, booked minutes and bookable minutes; busy minutes with set-up time, utilisation and the overload flag fill in, so a full day shows early.
One row per appointment: date, technician, service, client, status, minutes, price, tip, studio revenue and technician pay; revenue per hour and what the studio keeps after pay fill in by themselves.
Booth rent ledger with days late and arrears
One row per renter and month: rent due, due date, paid on and status; days late, arrears, rent collected and the late check fill in by themselves, so a late renter is never missed.
Rent chase log with the promised date check
One row per reminder sent to a renter: month, amount, date, channel, reply, promised date and status; days since the chase and the promise check fill in by themselves.
Commission statements with the pay run check
One row per month for the technician on commission: service revenue, commission percent and tips; the commission, the total to pay and a check against the pay run fill in by themselves.
Weekly timesheets with overtime and gross pay
One row per week and hourly staff member: hours, hourly rate and break minutes; overtime hours, gross pay with the overtime rule and hours on site fill in by themselves.
Tips ledger with the amount still to pass on
One row per technician and month: card tips, cash tips, the amount passed on and its status; the card fee, the amount to pass on, what is still owed and the tips share fill in by themselves.
Weekly schedules with hours against contract
One row per technician and week: days worked, hours planned and the chair or room; hours against the contract, planned minutes and bookable minutes fill in by themselves.
Time off with days off and the next 30 days
One row per leave: technician, first and last day, reason and who approved it; days off, the days that fall in the next 30 days and the time off check fill in by themselves.
The wanted utilisation and revenue per booked hour of each technician; the monthly pages compare the real figures with these targets.
Service mix by technician with share of revenue
One row per month, technician and service category: appointments and revenue; the technician revenue of the month, the share, the average ticket and the main-line check fill in by themselves.
Reviews by technician with the reply check
One row per review: date, client, technician, service, rating, topic and reply status; the waiting flag, the age and the reply check fill in by themselves.
Retail sales by technician with retail per client
One row per technician and month: retail sales and clients served; retail per client and the check against your wanted figure fill in. Booth renters sell their own retail, so their rows show zero.
Training log with the courses ahead
One row per course: technician, course, date, cost, whether it enables a new service and status; days to the course, the courses planned in the next 90 days and the course check fill in.
Check-ins with the review date check
One row per one-to-one check-in: technician, topic, outcome, next step, review date and the date it was reviewed; days to the review, the check-ins due in 30 days and the review check fill in.

The 20 services with price, product cost and standard pay; the margin per chair hour (what a service leaves after product and pay for each hour of a chair) fills in by itself.
